gap.reason: Same value, governed token: a gap Figma leaves unbound at 0 is the none of its family, and SOLAR picks the family by direction, as its own bound gaps do: a horizontal auto layout's gap is an inset, a vertical one's a stack (the Foundations agent reference and the Spatial chapter). Decided once here, as the paddings are.

docs.description: Previous/next arrow used inside Pagination. 10 variants: direction (previous/next) × state (default, hover, pressed, focus, disabled). Chevron icon flips by direction. Disabled when the pager is at the first (previous) or last (next) page. In RTL contexts, mirror via layout direction — do not swap the direction variant.

rules.reason:
The previous or next arrow of a Pagination, its description says: a button to the page before or after, disabled at the first and the last (`aria-disabled`), named for a screen reader. MUI's ButtonBase on the web, as a PaginationItem's; bespoke in Flutter. At 24 × 24,
  its target is its own box: the items sit 4px apart, where 44 × 44 targets would cover each
  other (owner decision 2026-09-24, as Tree Item's actions), which meets WCAG 2.2's 24px
  minimum; SOLAR accepted the exception on 2026-09-25.
The chevron points the way it goes: left for the previous page, right for the next, as its description says ("Chevron icon flips by direction").
